notes.title: UPDATE: SEASON1 Is Live
notes.content:
Dear Puzzlers,

after a lengthy design phase it has finally arrived.
We are happy to announce our first update that has just went live with [b]20 brand new levels[/b].

The levels are not restricted or locked. They can be freely played without requirements on completing the base game. Completing all 20 levels will grant you the [b]SEASON1 Completed achievement.[/b]

In the future we plan to release smaller updates more frequently so you don't have to wait like two months for the new content.

Enjoy the new challenges and have fun.
[h1]Tell your friends about it so they won't miss the fun.[/h1]
[h1][b]Want to be updated? Don't forget to follow us on steam and on social media.[/b][/h1]

notes.title: DevBlog: upcoming game update
notes.content:
Dear Puzzlers,

as promised, we're working hard to deliver our first major update for EXIT at absolutely no extra cost for you.
[h1]Expected release date is in the first half of February.[/h1]

Like in the base game you'll get carefully handcrafted puzzles, however, this time we're raising the bar even more.
[b]Over twenty brand new challenging levels waiting to be solved.[/b]

The new season will need to be unlocked by completing the base game with a high score.

Actually, we recommend playing the base game over a few times before this update goes live.

tags.feature: - Over twenty brand new challenging levels waiting to be solved.

notes.title: Launch date and features
notes.content:
[h1]
[b]EXIT[/b] launches on [b]16th, Dec 2016[/b].
[b]EXIT DEMO[/b] will be made available on steam one week earlier on [b]9th, Dec 2016[/b].
[/h1]

We introduced difficulty levels allowing to play with no time pressure.

The following steam features will come with the full version:
[list]
[*][b]Cloud saves[/b]
[*][b]Achievements[/b]
[*][b]Trading cards[/b]
[/list]

tags.feature: We introduced difficulty levels allowing to play with no time pressure.
